description: Reorder scheduled posts by permuting the times they already hold: same slots, reassigned in the order listed. All must be already scheduled; to move to a new time use draft_schedule. (Requires INSSIST PRO.)

draftIds.description: Scheduled post ids in wanted order, earliest slot first. At least two.

instance.description: Optional. Browser instance id from account_info; defaults to the active one.

name: draft_reorder
title: Draft reorder
